frozen_note: Committed before the first optimization run. Nothing here changes afterwards.
baseline: code defaults (R18) with SignalTF = period and the run_constants risk inputs
categorical_treatment: smoothing and neighbours use exact matches on categorical inputs; neighbours move one ordinal step on exactly one other input

selection.score: recovery factor (net profit / max equity DD), ineligible passes score 0
selection.smoothing: mean over the pass and its ordinal neighbours in the same categorical cell
selection.tie_break: closest to defaults (categorical mismatch 1, ordinal index steps), then smallest indices

gate_rule_changes: R42 (2026-10-01, user-directed at the R39 gate): after a TRADE_RETCODE_MARKET_CLOSED refusal the setup stays confirmed and placement is retried at most once per 60 s and 120 times, within OrderExpiryBars, re-running every check with the original prices. Fixes refusals previously misclassified as skipped_price_past; decided from the code defect, not from P&L.

R41 volume filter: added 2026-10-01 (both FVGs, then identifying FVG only), lookback corrected to a 24 h wall-clock window on 2026-10-02, then REMOVED on 2026-10-02 (AMENDMENT D, user-approved) after every filtered version was blocked by the R20 frequency rule (at most 1.25 fills/month). POST-EXPOSURE change: made after all pilots, including no-filter pilot v1 whose default-input P&L had been shown to the user (M15 net -2,152.53 USD, win rate 32.0%, max equity DD 31.1%; M5 net -7,490.24 USD). The filtered version and its evidence are archived in archive/2026-10-02-ob-fvg-volume-2x (tag archive/ob-fvg-volume-2x). No other trading rule changed and no filter was added.

Research hypothesis (AMENDMENT D): the sequence OB -> return to the OB -> new confirmation FVG -> retest of the FVG or the OB, with the stop beyond the OB and a 2R target, shows a robust out-of-sample edge without a volume filter, measured against the no-filter baseline (code defaults). Without an independent period the best possible deliverable is a candidate .set plus a forward-test protocol on new data.
